{{Quote|About 20 years ago, there was a good summer for breeding and all kinds of creatures started showing up.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Talus}}</ref>}}
'''Durbin''' was a village located on the [[Double Worlds|Twin]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. After being overrun by wild creatures, it was known as the '''Lost Village of Durbin'''.

==Description==
{{Quote|My dad said it was just a ways off from here. I'll mark the area on your datapad.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC" />}}
Located in the [[Akazi Plains]], east of [[Lake Thorn|Lake Bondoma]], the village of Durbin was surrounded by a winding [[river]] and a tall hill which was capped with a small [[Geyser/Legends|geyser]]. This geyser was surrounded by a number of berserk [[kahmurra]].<ref name="SWG:LVoD" />

==History==
{{Quote|I inherited a farm recently, but it's been overrun by all manners of creatures. I can't handle them myself, but if you can help clear them, I let you have any of the resources that are there.|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AC" />}}
The village of Durbin was once a growing settlement.<ref name="SWG:LVoD" /> However, around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="SWG:AC" /><ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the village was overrun by a horde of wild [[sludge panther]]s. Those who did not escape suffered a grisly demise, as evidenced by the number of [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletons]] strewn about the now abandoned village. It continued to be dangerously overrun by sludge panthers throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:LVoD" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], intrepid [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] would brave the now derelict village in order to either hunt the sludge panthers, or pillage the village of any remaining loot.<ref name="SWG:LVoD" /> Mysteriously, one spacer collected an [[acid sword]] named after [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter [[Sordaan Xris]]. The sword was found impaled in the skeletal remains of one of the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] villagers.<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

When the creatures invaded the village, a farmer was forced to abandon the farm he had built in Durbin.<ref name="SWG:AC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the farmer died and his son inherited the farm. The farmer's son requested a spacer to eliminate all the creatures in Lost Village of Durbin, to honor memory of the farmer.<ref name="SWG:AC" />
